meta.title: Requirements traceability - the nine named requirements
meta.author: arena/4a709dd0-korea2

status_values.implemented: exists in the repo and was re-checked in this session
status_values.partial: partially satisfied; gaps listed per row
status_values.proposed: specification published; not yet enforced in code

rows.requirement: Price-snapshot store that records opening and closing numbers for every market we originate
rows.where: price-desk/data/price_snapshots.csv (2,364 rows: every originated SPREAD/TOTAL/MONEYLINE market for both originating engines, 2023 REG - 2026 wk18 slate) + price_snapshots_props.csv (11,370 player-prop markets) + price-desk/pages/price-snapshots.html
rows.columns_published: our_fair_line, market_open_line, market_close_line, difference - each with its own *_status field
gaps: Opening numbers: no opening-line source covers the origination window (the only opening archive in the repo is WSGT 2021 spread/total). Open columns are BLANK with status blank-missing-no-source (flag PS-F-01). This is a data-availability gap, not a transcription gap.
Closing numbers come from a third-party archive (nflverse-derived games.csv.gz) - status archived-unverified. No official body publishes historical odds (flag PS-F-08).
rows.source: price-desk/scripts/build_store.py (reproducible build from named repo files)

rows.requirement: Verified results feed so backtests and ROI can be computed at all
gaps: 22 of 1,088 rows are verified-official (2026 weeks 8-10, read digit-for-digit from official NFL pages/gamebooks on 2026-11-14). 5 of these were cross-checkable against the archive and all 5 agreed; 17 filled scores the archive did not have at all.
931 rows are archived-unverified (values retained so backtests compute, never presented as verified).
135 rows are unsettled or missing (future games).
8 week-8 games: the official scores page returned 'Hidden Score' at retrieval - recorded without scores (flag PS-F-06). Official gamebooks exist for those games and can resolve them in a later pass.
Settlement against market prices uses archived third-party lines (line_status archived-unverified) because official odds do not exist (PS-F-08).
rows.source: https://www.nfl.com/scores/2026/week-9 (and week-8, week-10, game pages, gamebooks - full list in price-desk/data/sources.json)

rows.requirement: Originate the side first, then the total, then the moneyline
rows.where: origination-lab/scripts/build_lines.py originates SPREAD and TOTAL from the margin/total model first (build order: margin, total), then derives the MONEYLINE from the calibrated win probability (moneyline_calibration); price-desk/store rows are emitted in the same order (SPREAD, TOTAL, MONEYLINE) per game and keyed that way
gaps: The sequencing is a build-order convention, not a validation gate; if a future pipeline originates moneylines independently it must restate the order.
The root pipeline (data/derived/predictions.csv) originates only side and total - moneyline fair prices exist only on the origination-lab slate (164 games).

rows.requirement: Publish the model's fair line, the market line, and the difference as separate columns
rows.status: implemented-this-session (and already present on earlier boards)
rows.where: price-desk/data/price_snapshots.csv columns our_fair_line | market_close_line | difference (each with status); origination/site_data/current_board.csv already publishes own_spread/own_total | mkt_spread/mkt_total | edge_spread/edge_total as separate columns
gaps: The difference column is computed (our_fair_line - market_close_line) and inherits the archived-unverified status of the market side.

For the origination-lab slate the published 'our_spread' uses display convention (negative = home favourite); the store converts it to home-margin convention before differencing (conversion verified against our_home_win_prob and edge_home_pts - see price-desk/tests).

rows.requirement: Separate 'signal' from 'staking' in the leaderboard so a lucky staking run cannot mask a bad signal
rows.where: price-desk/data/leaderboard_split.json + price-desk/pages/leaderboard.html: signal block (flat-stake, luck-controlled: permutation p, deflated Sharpe, season-block CI) ranks strategies; staking block (declared plan + realised plan outcome) is displayed separately and never affects rank
gaps: Realised staking outcomes are blank (no live bankroll ledger exists) - blank by policy, not inferred.
No strategy currently passes the validation gates (all tiers NEEDS_REVIEW/REJECTED, reward_points 0); the rewards pool is unfunded (flag PS-F-07).
rows.source: origination/site_data/leaderboard.csv (flat-stake ledger with luck controls), data/strategies.json (declared staking plans)

rows.requirement: Track the depth of the replacement, not just the fact of a replacement
rows.status: partial (schema + official sources identified; string-depth labels have no official source)
rows.where: site/data/injury_depth.json (108 players transcribed from the official Week 10 injury report, replacement-string cells deliberately blank per policy), nfl-command/data/depth.json (per-team starter/2nd/3rd/4th columns, all blank: no official depth chart reachable - FL-15). NEW this session: official NFL gamebooks publish the actual starting lineups plus Did-Not-Play/Not-Active lists per game - demonstrated and transcribed for WAS@NYG 2026 wk10 in price-desk/data/verified_results_2026.json (official_gamebook_discovery)
gaps: No official source labels players as 2nd/3rd/4th string (confirmed: NFL team depth-chart URLs return 404 - FL-15). The gamebook gives WHO started (official fact) but not the depth string of the replacement.
A gamebook ingestion pipeline is not built yet (suggestion S-02). Until then, replacement depth stays blank rather than inferred.

rows.requirement: Compute correlations only from officially sourced numbers and publish n with each value
rows.where: correlation tables across the repo publish n with each value (e.g., results/correlations.json publishes n = 6,021 with the headline pair; data/derived/correlation.json and lab pages likewise)
gaps: The correlation INPUTS are third-party archives (nflverse-derived datasets), not officially sourced numbers - every correlation value in the repo is therefore flagged as archive-based. Strictly official recomputation needs the verified results feed to grow (S-02).
data/correlations.json COR-04 carried a reversed interpretation of positive correlation (issue #16); corrected by this session (PS-6).
rows.source: results/correlations.json; data/correlations.json (COR-04 fix recorded in COORDINATION.md PS-6)

rows.requirement: Define a demotion gate that sends a live strategy back to paper
rows.status: proposed (spec complete; no live strategy exists to enforce it on today)
rows.where: price-desk/data/demotion_gate.json + price-desk/pages/gates.html (five triggers, evaluation cadence, re-promotion rules, open parameters). quant-lab/leaderboard.html holds the earlier one-line sketch.
gaps: Owner decision needed on the open parameters (window length, p threshold, drawdown cap) - see S-07.
Not yet wired into code because no strategy has passed the promotion gates.

rows.requirement: Suggestions section where reviewers choose the best path before implementing, plus a pre-decision Q&A list of questions/information/answers
rows.where: price-desk/pages/suggestions.html + price-desk/data/suggestions_queue.json (each suggestion carries options, trade-offs, a recommended path and a status field so the owner can choose before anything is implemented); price-desk/pages/questions.html + price-desk/data/questions.json (question / information needed / known answers with sources / what is missing / discovery suggestions). Earlier hubs (suggestions/, decision-desk, decision-hub, review-board) remain live and are cross-linked.
gaps: Duplicate suggestion hubs exist across sessions (flag PS-F-13) - consolidation is itself queued as S-04.
